header: Supported Regions for OpenSearch Serverless service-linked roles
content:
OpenSearch Serverless supports using the AWSServiceRoleForAmazonOpenSearchServerless
service-linked role in every Region where OpenSearch Serverless is available. For a list of supported
Regions, see Amazon OpenSearch Serverless endpoints and quotas in the AWS General Reference.
